asset.title: Live Convex Broad Proof 20260620
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video provides a solid, end-to-end demonstration of NodeRoom's multi-surface workspace, showcasing the document memo, sticky note wall, and financial spreadsheet with live agent traces and conflict resolution.

featureClarity.evidence: Clearly demonstrates navigating between the memo, risk wall, and spreadsheet, though the rapid transitions require close attention.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the complete flow from entering the room, switching views, editing a cell, and observing the resulting trace logs.

visualDesign.evidence: High-density dark UI with a clean layout reminiscent of modern developer tools, though the interface is somewhat crowded.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the product narrative, showing the integration of spreadsheets, notes, and agent traces.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic browser capture showing real-time UI updates, cursor movements, and trace logs.

legibility.evidence: Small text in the sidebar and trace logs is readable at full resolution but challenging on smaller screens.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant to financial and diligence workflows, demonstrating structured data management and auditability.

productionHonesty.evidence: Explicitly displays conflict warnings and trace logs, showing the actual system behavior without embellishment.

observedEvidence: Multi-client sync and navigation across memo, wall, and spreadsheet views
Live agent chat interaction and private/public toggle
Spreadsheet cell editing with real-time variance calculation
Trace log updating with conflict resolution status ('did not overwrite')

defects.observed: The text in the trace log and chat panels is quite small and may be difficult to read on standard README displays.
defects.fix: Increase the default zoom level of the browser slightly during recording to improve text legibility.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeRoom in action: a live, multi-surface diligence room featuring real-time spreadsheet collaboration, interactive risk walls, and automated agent trace logging.
